- Economic buyer: Priya Shah (Head of Product) — will sign off on business terms and budget
- Procurement / purchasing: Jared Thompson — will own PO process and vendor intake
- Legal / Contracts: Sangeeta Patel (Legal Ops) — will own NDA/MSA review and redlines

3) Procurement / PO — Jared, please confirm if Acme requires any specific billing address, W9, or purchase order workflow.
4) Decision criteria — Priya, can you confirm the top 3 technical/economic decision criteria (latency SLOs, cost per 1M tokens, and data residency)? We'll use these to prioritize model/infra recommendations.

Attachments: Redwood_NDA_v1.docx (attached) and Redwood_MSA_Draft_v1.docx (draft for reference).

- Marissa (me): send NDA to Sangeeta / LegalOps once confirm contact + track timelines

- Priya: confirm decision criteria and expected go-live window (Q1 / Q2)

Marissa — thanks for the ping and file. I've assigned Neha to own the review for this account and sketched a recommended sequencing below: 

Planned sequencing & estimated turn times (internal):
- NDA (mutual, standard): Neha will review and provide comments within 1 business day; target execution within 2–3 business days after external acknowledgement.
- MSA (commercial): Once NDA is executed we will push the MSA redline. First-pass redline expected in 7 business days; full negotiation can take 10–14 business days depending on complexity.
- DPA (data protection): We will run DPA review in parallel with MSA where possible but security will own final sign-off. Expect 5–8 business days for initial review.

Redline sequencing suggestion: NDA -> MSA draft -> DPA parallel review (security comments merged into MSA where applicable). If Acme has specific security controls (KMS/HSM, data residency), dev_team (aditya/dev) should prepare a short security spec to attach to the DPA review.

Required intake items (please gather before legal kickoff):
- Confirm legal point of contact and signer (Sangeeta to confirm)
- Billing address + W9 for procurement
- Any specific SSO/KMS/HSM requirements for the DPA
- Example clause preferences if any (e.g. liability cap, indemnity tweaks)

I'll attach our MSA redline guidelines to this thread for your reference. We'll aim to keep turnaround tight given the deal timeline — Neha will reach out to Sangeeta directly to coordinate.
